## Description / 变更描述
Please include a summary of the change and which issue it fixes. / 请简要概括此次变更的内容及关联的 Issue。

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change / 变更类型
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue / 缺陷修复)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality / 新功能)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected / 破坏性变更)
- [ ] Documentation update (文档补充或修正)
- [ ] Code style or refactoring (代码风格微调或重构)

## Checklist / 提交前核对清单
- [ ] My code follows the code style of this project (`composer cs-check` passed).
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works (`composer test` passed).
- [ ] Static analysis passed (`composer phpstan` passed).
